WHO WE ARE
 

Boutique private equity
Real estate firm

Carolina Capital Real Estate Partners (Carolina Capital) is a private equity real estate investment firm headquartered in Charlotte, N.C. and active in major metropolitan markets throughout the United States.

Carolina Capital specializes in the acquisition, development, management, and disposition of mid-size land and income-producing commercial and residential properties.

The firm utilizes its extensive market knowledge, operational and management expertise to reposition and add value to each and every asset.  Carolina Capital has a 15-year reputation as a trusted general partner with high attention to detail, strong performance, and above market returns for its investors.
